# langsmith_org_members (Data Source)

Lists all members of the current LangSmith organization, including pending invitations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_org_members" "all" {}

output "org_member_emails" {
  value = [for m in data.langsmith_org_members.all.members : m.email]
}

output "pending_invitations" {
  value = [for p in data.langsmith_org_members.all.pending : p.email]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) The members of the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization.
- `pending` (Attributes List) Pending organization invitations that have not been accepted yet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pending))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `access_scope` (String) The member's access scope (e.g. `workspace` or `organization`).
- `created_at` (String) When the member joined the organization.
- `email` (String) The member's email address.
- `full_name` (String) The member's full name.
- `id` (String) The organization member identity ID.
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the member is disabled.
- `ls_user_id` (String) The LangSmith user ID of the member.
- `org_role_id` (String) The organization role ID of the member.
- `org_role_name` (String) The organization role name of the member.
- `role_id` (String) The workspace role ID of the member, if any.
- `role_name` (String) The workspace role name of the member, if any.
- `user_id` (String) The user ID of the member.
- `workspace_ids` (List of String) The IDs of the workspaces this member belongs to (returned by the API as `tenant_ids`).


<a id="nestedatt--pending"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pending`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the invitation was created.
- `email` (String) The invited email address.
- `full_name` (String) The invitee's full name.
- `id` (String) The pending invitation ID.
- `org_role_id` (String) The organization role ID assigned to the invitee.
- `org_role_name` (String) The organization role name assigned to the invitee.
- `role_id` (String) The workspace role ID assigned to the invitee, if any.
- `role_name` (String) The workspace role name assigned to the invitee, if any.
